UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated player account profile linked to Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

email.description: Verified email address of the signed-in user (PII, owner-only).

photoURL.description: Profile avatar URL from Google Sign-In or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update.

GameSave.title: Franchise Game Save
GameSave.description: Cloud-persisted franchise draft, Playing XI, active season, settings, and career progression for a signed-in user.

ownerUid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching parent userId.

squadCount.description: Number of drafted players currently in the squad.

settings.description: Draft and match configuration settings map.

draft.description: Draft state including custom franchise, purse, squad, retentions, and spin history.

playingXi.description: Selected Playing XI IDs, captain, wicketkeeper, and confirmation flag.

career.description: Career seasons played, titles won, best finish, and unlocked achievements.

season.description: Active season state map or null when no season has started.

activeMatch.description: Reference to an in-progress league or playoff match, or null.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when cloud save was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest cloud save update.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only private profile document for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/gameSaves/{saveId}.description: Owner-only cloud save slot (e.g. saveId='current') storing user franchise, draft, Playing XI, season, and career progression.
